name: Supernotes
description_en:
Supernotes is a card-based note workspace with Markdown content, links, nested organisation, search and collaboration. Cards can contain equations, tables, images and checklists, while graph, calendar and other layouts offer different ways to revisit the same knowledge.

The free Starter plan is a persistent card allowance, not an unlimited-note plan. Unlimited adds card creation capacity and selected AI/API features; access to existing cards and the ability to acquire more cards are separate conditions.
description_zh:
Supernotes 是卡片式笔记工作区，提供 Markdown 内容、链接、嵌套组织、搜索与协作。卡片可包含公式、表格、图片和清单，图谱、日历等布局让同一知识从不同方式被重新查看。

免费 Starter 是持续存在的卡片额度，并非笔记无限。Unlimited 增加卡片创建容量和部分 AI／API 能力；访问已有卡片与继续获取新卡片是不同条件。

core_features.explanation_en: Create short rich cards and organise through links, nesting and tags.
core_features.explanation_zh: 建立简短富内容卡片，通过链接、嵌套与标签组织。

core_features.explanation_en: Offline changes sync after reconnection; Markdown export is documented.
core_features.explanation_zh: 离线修改在重连后同步，文档提供 Markdown 导出。

core_features.explanation_en: Share cards for reading and collaborate through editing/comments.
core_features.explanation_zh: 分享卡片供阅读，并通过编辑／评论协作。

en: Keep concise linked lecture or project knowledge.
zh: 保存简洁关联的课堂或项目知识。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Vendor sync with web, desktop and mobile apps; no self-hosted distribution verified.
Deployment.zh: 厂商同步与 Web、桌面、移动应用；未核实自行托管发行版。

steps.en: Create a few concise cards and link/tag a small topic.
steps.zh: 创建几张简短卡片，关联／标记一个小主题。

steps.en: Inspect kept-card usage and sharing roles before inviting a group.
steps.zh: 邀请群体前，检查保留卡用量与共享角色。

steps.en: Export Markdown and test offline edits/reconnection with non-sensitive notes.
steps.zh: 导出 Markdown，并用非敏感笔记测试离线修改／重连。

items.en: Supernotes suits concise linked knowledge and selective collaboration. Long document drafting or strict end-to-end encryption requirements need a separate fit check. The feature page describes encryption in transit and at rest, and limited staff access with support permission; that should not be relabelled end-to-end encryption. No self-hosted package or application licence was verified. Opt-in AI, offline conflict recovery, location capture and recipient permissions were not tested in this research.
items.zh: Supernotes 适合简洁关联知识与选择性协作。长文写作或严格端到端加密需求应单独核实。功能页说明传输和静态加密，以及经支持许可的有限员工访问；不能改写为端到端加密。未核实自行托管包或应用许可。本次没有测试自愿启用的 AI、离线冲突恢复、位置记录或接收者权限。

pricing.billing_basis: Persistent Starter card allowance or Unlimited cadence; regional/store prices differ.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Starter 100 cards with earning options; annual GBP Unlimited £72/year (£6/month equivalent). No card-based paid trial assumed.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Starter 100 张卡，可额外获取；英镑年度 Unlimited 每年 £72（每月折算 £6）。不默认有付费试用。

review_notes: Primary-source research is a draft, not publication, owner verification, price approval or independent review.
English and Chinese carry matching amounts, billing periods, qualifications and unknowns.
Historical directory assertions are superseded, including unverified feature and API labels.

sections.title_en: Capture a small idea and link its context
sections.title_zh: 采集小想法并关联上下文
sections.en: For an illustrative lecture summary, create one card per concept, add tags and link related concepts instead of copying the entire lecture into one file. Pricing describes a 1,200-character soft limit that can overflow, so it is guidance for concise ideas rather than a hard truncation rule. Sharing a card for reading does not require the recipient to have Supernotes; editing/commenting uses its collaboration model. Check the intended role before distributing a card.
sections.zh: 例如整理课堂摘要时，可每个概念建一张卡，加标签并关联概念，而不是把整堂课复制进单一文件。定价说明 1,200 字符为可超出的软限制，属于鼓励简洁想法的设计，并非硬截断规则。分享卡片供阅读不要求接收者有 Supernotes；编辑／评论使用其协作模式。分发前应核对目标角色。

sections.title_en: What happens at the free card ceiling
sections.title_zh: 达到免费卡片上限后会怎样
sections.en: Starter starts with 100 cards, with additional cards through achievements/referrals. The FAQ explains that kept cards include those a user creates, joins, likes or edits. At the limit, existing kept cards remain viewable/editable, but creating, liking or joining new cards stops. Unlimited removes that count restriction. The annual GBP view shows £6/month billed £72 annually; other cadence, student and four-year offers exist, with regional/store differences. It is not a £6 cancel-anytime monthly bill.
sections.zh: Starter 从 100 张卡开始，可通过成就／推荐增加。FAQ 说明“保留”卡片包括用户创建、加入、点赞或编辑的卡。达上限后，已有保留卡仍可查看／编辑，但无法新建、点赞或加入新卡。Unlimited 去除数量限制。英镑年度视图显示每月折算 £6、年付 £72；另有其他账期、学生和四年方案，并存在地区／商店差异。不能把它写成每月付 £6 的按月方案。

sections.title_zh: 离线工作与 Markdown 导出
sections.en: The feature page documents offline creation/editing followed by automatic merging/sync after reconnection, plus Markdown export at any time. It describes imports from common tools and plain Markdown, but import claims are not a migration-fidelity test. Try links, equations and images in a representative import/export and keep an independent copy before bulk migration. API limits are higher in Unlimited; the presence of an API does not establish unlimited automation on Starter.
sections.zh: 功能页说明离线创建／编辑后，重新连接时自动合并和同步，并可随时导出 Markdown。它列出从常见工具及纯 Markdown 导入，但导入宣传不等于迁移保真度测试。大量迁移前，应以代表性内容核对链接、公式和图片的导入／导出，并保留独立副本。Unlimited 的 API 限额更高；存在 API 不代表 Starter 可无限自动化。

sections.title_en: Short connected notes versus a private vault
sections.title_zh: 短关联笔记与私密保险库的边界
sections.en: Supernotes suits concise linked knowledge and selective collaboration. Long document drafting or strict end-to-end encryption requirements need a separate fit check. The feature page describes encryption in transit and at rest, and limited staff access with support permission; that should not be relabelled end-to-end encryption. No self-hosted package or application licence was verified. Opt-in AI, offline conflict recovery, location capture and recipient permissions were not tested in this research.
sections.zh: Supernotes 适合简洁关联知识与选择性协作。长文写作或严格端到端加密需求应单独核实。功能页说明传输和静态加密，以及经支持许可的有限员工访问；不能改写为端到端加密。未核实自行托管包或应用许可。本次没有测试自愿启用的 AI、离线冲突恢复、位置记录或接收者权限。

research_gaps.en: No live card sharing, offline conflict, import/export fidelity, AI quality, API usage or location controls were tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试真实卡片共享、离线冲突、导入／导出保真度、AI 质量、API 用量或位置控制。
